test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Observe the bar graph showing the number of students in different sections of a school and answer the question. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/047465356df5f9382d94fe198093d1a4f4a26766689bc07f8d81df01b002577f.png] 

What is the difference between the average number of students in the 3 most populated sections and the 3 least populated sections?
solution:
**SOLUTION:**

The 3 most populated sections are section 1, Section 5, Section 6.

The 3 least populated sections are Section 3, Section 2, Section 4.

The number of Students in Section 1 = 60

The number of Students in Section 5 = 70

The number of Students in Section 6 = 50

The number of Students in Section 3 = 20

The number of Students in Section 4 = 40

The number of Students in Section 2 = 30

The average number of students in the 3 most populated sections and the 3 least populated sections = 70 + 60 + 50 / 3 - 20 + 30 + 40 / 3

Average = 60 - 30

Average = 30

Hence option 2 is the valid answer.
